body.name: Informative denominator-lock mechanisms
body.construction: On \(\mathcal D_{\mathrm{inf}}\), set \(P(U_i=1)=1/2\), \(P(X_i=1\mid U_i=0)=1/4\), \(P(X_i=1\mid U_i=1)=3/4\), and \(P_{\sigma}(Y_i=1\mid X_i=a,U_i=u)=1/2+\sigma(u-r_a)/4\). Set \(P(C_i=1\mid Y_i=0)=1/4\), \(P(C_i=1\mid Y_i=1)=3/4\), and \(P(S_i=1\mid Y_i=b,C_i=d)=1/4\) when \(b=d\) and \(3/4\) otherwise. All Bernoulli complements use one minus the displayed entry; \(\mathbf M_{\mathrm{inf},+}\) and \(\mathbf M_{\mathrm{inf},-}\) use \(\sigma=+1\) and \(\sigma=-1\).
